changelog:
v4.2.1 DPI Sensitivity Engine Fix & Enhancements:
• Base DPI set to exact default 371 DP.
• DPI feature placed at the FIRST PLACE INSIDE the floating in-game bar (FloatingMenuView) and main screen.
• Dedicated, prominent ACTIVATE DPI and DEACTIVATE DPI buttons for instant 1-tap switching.
• True system density switching (su wm density, Settings.Secure display_density_forced, OEM touch boost).
• All v4.1.0 features 100% preserved (Volume Up+Down unhide shortcut, 6 zones, 144Hz multi-touch).
• Permanent release signing key prevents package conflicts.
